connections.observation: The εἴδωλον/ἀληθές contrast (s009) is enacted by the ἔξω/ἐντός contrast (s002): the image of justice pertains to external action (craftsmen doing their work), while true justice pertains to what is inside (περὶ τὴν ἐντός). The two contrasts map onto one another, making visible that the image-truth distinction is also an outside-inside distinction.

The three notes of the harmonic scale—νεάτης, ὑπάτης, μέσης (s006)—give precise musical content to the harmonic vocabulary cluster (s005). The συναρμόσαντα, ἁρμονία, and ἡρμοσμένον are not general metaphors but name the tuning of specific intervals. Held together, the two signals make audible that the soul's unity is configured as an actual musical attunement.

The ἐνύπνιον (s008) and κατὰ θεόν τινα (s014) both characterize the discovery as unintentional or given from beyond deliberate searching. The dream they suspect fulfilled and the divine guidance into a τύπος together articulate a doubled mode of arrival—neither fully waking rational construction nor fully conscious intention.

The recurrence of τὰ αὑτοῦ πράττειν (s001) across εἴδωλον and ἀληθές (s009) makes visible that the same formula names both the image (craftsmen) and the truth (soul-parts). The formula does not change; what changes is the domain of its application—from external crafts to internal soul-elements.

Becoming ἕνα ἐκ πολλῶν through συνδήσαντα (s015) is the harmonic result named by σώφρονα καὶ ἡρμοσμένον. The binding together (συνδήσαντα) and the harmonic vocabulary (s005: συναρμόσαντα, ἡρμοσμένον) converge: unity from multiplicity is simultaneously a binding and a tuning, making audible that psychic integration is configured as achieving concordant pitch.

The recurrence of ἄρχω (s003) and πράττω (s001) together articulate the double axis of justice: who rules (ἄρχειν/ἄρχεσθαι) determines who does what (τὰ αὑτοῦ πράττειν). The legitimate rule of the λογιστικόν enables each part to do its own; illegitimate seizure of rule by the ἐπιθυμητικόν produces πολυπραγμονεῖν and τἀλλότρια πράττειν.

The catalogue of injustices (s011) tests whether τὰ αὑτοῦ πράττειν (s001) holds under external temptation. Each named crime—deposit-theft, sacrilege, adultery, parental neglect, cultic neglect—would require a soul-part to do what is ἀλλότριον to it. Held together, the two signals make visible that external wrongdoing is the behavioral signature of internal τἀλλότρια πράττειν.

The tightening and loosening (ἐπιτείνουσα/ἀνιεῖσα, s007) names the tuning action by which μουσική and γυμναστική produce σύμφωνα (s005). The contrasted verbs specify the bidirectional adjustment required for harmonic concordance, making visible that achieving ἁρμονία requires not uniform intensity but calibrated tension and release on different soul-parts.

The just/unjust action pair (s012) is defined by whether it preserves (σῴζῃ καὶ συναπεργάζηται) or dissolves (λύῃ) the ἕξις. This preservation/dissolution criterion makes visible that τὰ αὑτοῦ πράττειν (s001) is not a static state but a configuration that each action either maintains or undoes.

The ἴσα τὸν ἀριθμόν correspondence of city and soul (s013) grounds the serial application of the four virtues (s004) to both. The numerical equality makes visible that the virtues are not transferred by analogy but are identically located in structurally identical tripartite configurations.

The ἀπληστότατον appetitive part (s016) that may seize rule (ἄρχειν ἐπιχειρήσῃ, s003) connects insatiability to usurpation. The most unfillable part is precisely the one that would enslave and rule what is not proper to its kind (ὧν οὐ προσῆκον αὐτῷ γένει), making visible that appetitive tyranny is grounded in structural unfillability.

The doubled μνημονευτέον answered by the doubled negative ἐπιλελήσμεθα/ἐπιλελῆσθαι (s017) surrounds the formula τὸ ἑαυτοῦ ἕκαστον πράττειν (s001). The emphatic remembering-not-forgetting makes this formula itself the object requiring memory, marking it as something already established that must not slip away in the transition from city to soul.

The three harmonic notes (νεάτης, ὑπάτης, μέσης, s006) and the becoming ἕνα ἐκ πολλῶν (s015) together configure the soul's unification as a musical interval-structure. The lowest, highest, and middle notes bound together (συνδήσαντα) name the multiplicity from which the one is generated, making audible that psychic unity preserves rather than erases the three distinct pitches.

The morphological doubling of cobbler/cobbling and carpenter/carpentering (σκυτοτομικός/σκυτοτομεῖν, τεκτονικός/τεκταίνεσθαι, s010) intensifies the εἴδωλον passage (s009). The cognate-verb construction makes each craftsman's identity inseparable from his activity, so that the εἴδωλον itself enacts in linguistic form the principle it images: being and doing are grammatically fused.

elements.context: τῷ κοινῷ σφῶν αὐτῶν τριῶν ὄντων

new_signals.observation: The number three recurs emphatically: τριῶν γενῶν, τριῶν ὄντων (twice), τρία ὄντα, τρεῖς ὅρους. The repetition marks threeness itself as a structural principle requiring preservation through the soul's unification.

elements.context: ἣ ἂν ταύτην τὴν ἕξιν σῴζῃ τε καὶ συναπεργάζηται
ὅταν αὐτοῦ τὸ θυμοειδὲς διασῴζῃ διά τε λυπῶν καὶ ἡδονῶν τὸ ὑπὸ τῶν λόγων παραγγελθὲν δεινόν τε καὶ μή

new_signals.observation: σῴζω recurs as preserving: θυμοειδές preserves (διασῴζῃ) the λόγος-commanded distinction through pains and pleasures; just action preserves (σῴζῃ) the soul's ἕξις. Both name a preserving-through that maintains a configuration across potentially dissolving forces.

elements.context: μὴ ἐάσαντα τἀλλότρια πράττειν ἕκαστον ἐν αὑτῷ

new_signals.observation: λογιστικόν and θυμοειδές guard against enemies from outside (ἔξωθεν πολεμίους); the just configuration prevents τἀλλότρια πράττειν of parts within (ἐν αὑτῷ). The outside/inside pairing makes visible a double front of guardianship—external defense and internal order.

elements.context: τῇ φιλίᾳ καὶ συμφωνίᾳ τῇ αὐτῶν τούτων

new_signals.observation: Temperance is defined by φιλία among the three parts; the just person becomes φίλος to himself. The shift from abstract noun (φιλία) to adjective-substantive (φίλον) marks self-friendship as the achieved relational state that φιλία among parts produces.
